scoring_justification: The agent's only scored artifact is the final entropy value; a full recompute of the integration from the agent's raw intermediate points is not feasible because those are not captured. A result-level comparison to the paper's gold within a tolerance is acceptable.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold entropy value for result-level comparison
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table V: S(298.16) liquid = 48.84 cal/deg
hidden_assets.generation_method: Directly taken from the paper's reported value
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: The value is the paper's own reported result, used as a reference for comparison.

outputs.description: The computed molal entropy of liquid cyclohexane at 298.16 K, in cal/deg/mole.
